agent_runs.answer: Found 5 policies with payout schedules: Scott Neil Davis (POL00000011, VUL frequency, $35,512.98 dividend; and POL00000018, Quarterly, $7,974.37 withdrawal), Thomas Jill Davis (POL00000013, Monthly, no amount listed), Jared Xavier Parker (POL00000014, VUL, $22,974.07 claim), and Blake Katelyn Myers (POL00000019, Monthly, $45,669.28 claim).
agent_runs.agent_sql:
SELECT
  COALESCE(p.full_name, CONCAT(p.first_name, ' ', p.last_name)) AS policyholder_name,
  COALESCE(pp.premium_mode, c.product_code) AS payout_frequency,
  fa.transaction_amount AS projected_next_payout_amount,
  fa.activity_type AS payout_type,
  ad.holding_id AS policy_id
FROM normalized.annuity_detail ad
JOIN normalized.coverage c
  ON c.holding_id = ad.holding_id AND c.is_deleted = false
JOIN normalized.party p
  ON p.party_id = CONCAT('PARTY#', c.party_id) AND p.is_deleted = false
LEFT JOIN normalized.policy_product pp
  ON pp.product_code = c.product_code
LEFT JOIN normalized.financial_activity fa
  ON fa.holding_id = ad.holding_id
  AND fa.activity_type IN ('Withdrawal', 'Dividend', 'Claim')
  AND fa.is_deleted = false
WHERE ad.deleted = false
ORDER BY ad.holding_id, fa.effective_date DESC

agent_runs.agent_sql:
WITH party_mv AS (
  SELECT p.party_id, p.full_name, SUM(h.market_value) AS total_market_value
  FROM normalized.party p
  JOIN normalized.coverage c ON CONCAT('PARTY#', c.party_id) = p.party_id
  JOIN normalized.holding h ON c.holding_id = h.holding_id
  WHERE p.is_deleted = false AND h.is_deleted = false
  GROUP BY p.party_id, p.full_name
),
party_products AS (
  SELECT p.party_id,
         ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT ip.product_name) AS product_names
  FROM normalized.party p
  JOIN normalized.coverage c ON CONCAT('PARTY#', c.party_id) = p.party_id
  JOIN normalized.holding h ON c.holding_id = h.holding_id
  LEFT JOIN normalized.holding_subaccount hs ON hs.holding_id = h.holding_id AND hs.deleted = false
  LEFT JOIN normalized.invest_product ip ON hs.invest_product_id = ip.invest_product_id AND ip.is_deleted = false
  WHERE p.is_deleted = false AND h.is_deleted = false
  GROUP BY p.party_id
)
SELECT
  pm.party_id,
  pm.full_name,
  pm.total_market_value,
  ARRAY_JOIN(COALESCE(pp.product_names, ARRAY['N/A']), ', ') AS product_names
FROM party_mv pm
LEFT JOIN party_products pp ON pm.party_id = pp.party_id
ORDER BY pm.total_market_value DESC
